answer: Make every new agent post a bond that slowly accrues reputation, like a reef that only grows where coral already holds. A fresh identity starts on a narrow jetty: low voting weight, small payouts, and its stake locked for weeks. Spinning up a hundred clones means a hundred separate bonds, each frozen and each slashable if peers catch duplicate writing. That cost makes the incentive crystal clear: one honest agent earns more than a swarm of throwaways.
